evals.name: mongodb-paged-read-model
evals.prompt: In an Arc for TypeScript server, serve a TaskRecord (Guid id, string title) from MongoDB as a paged, sortable list. Show the model, query and builder registration. Give the code in your reply; do not write files.
evals.expected_output: A TaskRecord with @field and @key() id, a mongoCollection token injected with service(), queryOptions() and queryPage({}, options), and withMongoDB registering the model in readModels.
assertions: Declares @field metadata and marks the id with @key().
Injects mongoCollection(TaskRecord) with service(...) and uses queryPage(filter, options) instead of slicing in memory.
Registers the model with withMongoDB({ client, database, readModels: [TaskRecord] }).
Notes that the database follows the resolved tenant rather than a query argument.

evals.name: drizzle-column-codecs
evals.prompt: Our Arc for TypeScript read model has a Guid id, a string title and a DateOnly dueOn, stored in PostgreSQL through Drizzle. Show the table, the model and the registration, and say who creates the column. Reply only.
evals.expected_output: pgTable with pgColumn(guidCodec(DrizzleDialect.PostgreSQL)) primary key, pgColumn(dateOnlyCodec) for dueOn, matching @field properties, withDrizzle with readModels table mapping; Arc never alters the schema.
assertions: Uses guidCodec and dateOnlyCodec wrapped by pgColumn.
Matches each @field to a table column under the same property key and requires a primary key.
Registers with withDrizzle({ dialect, database or databaseFactory, readModels: [{ type, table }] }).
States Arc never creates or migrates the database; the application owns the migration.

evals.name: postgres-observation
evals.prompt: A live Arc for TypeScript query over a Drizzle PostgreSQL table must update when another process writes. What do we configure and what are the limits? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: DrizzleObservation.PostgreSQLNotify with a trigger installed by an application migration (postgresqlChangeTrigger) and a dedicated pg.Client listener via nodePostgresListener; NOTIFY is not durable.
assertions: Selects DrizzleObservation.PostgreSQLNotify rather than InProcess for other processes.
Installs triggers through an application migration using postgresqlChangeTrigger because Arc creates no database objects at runtime.
Supplies a new dedicated pg.Client per tenant through nodePostgresListener.
Warns that NOTIFY is not a durable log and intermediate states during a disconnect are not replayed.
